provenance: Analytic synthetic verification inputs, not manufacturer specifications or measured site observations.

monetary_policy.grid_invoice_unit: physical grid source and absolute hour
monetary_policy.customer_invoice_unit: cumulative delivered session energy; incremental cents recognized in each delivery interval
monetary_policy.completion_count_interval: half-open [hour start, hour end); completion exactly at hour end counts in next hour
monetary_policy.unfinished_session_revenue: recognized for energy delivered by horizon end

cases.name: Three-day SST swap inventory cycle
cases.calculation: Each daily 100 kWh swap per site is fully restored in 2 h after its 7.5 min service. No inventory reset occurs. Each 200 kWh daily restoration needs 200/(0.98*0.95) grid kWh.

cases.name: Four-day transformer and PCS EV charging with continuous AC load
cases.calculation: Daily customer EV energy is 200 kWh, AC auxiliary energy is 2*10*24=480 kWh. Transformer input is (200/(0.96*0.95)+480)/0.98; the AC branch bypasses PCS and DD. Initial batteries remain full and unchanged.

cases.name: Five-day cross-site supply with overnight charging, outage, queue recovery and inventory deficit
cases.calculation: After each 23:07.5 swap completion, 52.5 min of 50 kW restoration reaches 43.75 kWh at midnight. Days 2 and 3 have no grid import; their requests wait. Day 4 grid return replenishes 56.25 kWh/site in 67.5 min, then queued swaps start at 01:07.5 and 03:15. Day 4 day-total restoration 300 kWh/site; day 5 restoration 100 kWh/site. All 10 swaps finish; ending inventory 87.5 kWh is 112.5 below initial.
